description: This file defines the DgContainer class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling Escher drawing container data such as drawing IDs, shape IDs, and the shape group container. It includes methods for getting and setting these properties, and handles exceptions related to null spgrContainer references.

classes.name: DgContainer
classes.description: Represents a drawing container with properties such as drawing ID, last shape ID, and shape group container, with methods to access and modify these properties and handle related exceptions.

methods.name: getDgId
methods.description: Returns the drawing index (1-based) for this container.

methods.name: setDgId
methods.description: Sets the drawing index with an integer value.

methods.name: getLastSpId
methods.description: Returns the last shape index within this drawing.

methods.name: getSpgrContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the shape group container if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: getSpgrContainerOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the shape group container or throws an exception if it is null.
